title: Solver report human-Agent decision tree
description: A scenario-specific, evidence-bound decision tree that explains which facts humans confirm, which reasoning Agents perform, which gates can block delivery, and which path was actually taken.

schemaVersion.description: Version of the stable decision-tree interchange contract.

rootNodeId.description: ID of the first node on the scenario decision path.

nodes.description: Decision, gate, action, and outcome nodes. Business wording is derived from scenario evidence rather than UI code.

id.description: Stable node identifier within one tree.

kind.description: Visual and semantic role of the node.

owner.description: Party responsible for confirming or performing this step.

title.description: Plain-language step or question shown to non-algorithm users.

detail.description: Scenario-specific explanation of the step, rule, or outcome.

status.description: Observed state in this evidence run; guard and blocked nodes explain non-delivery paths.

evidenceRef.description: In-page anchor where a reviewer can inspect the supporting evidence.

edges.description: Directed branches between nodes. Exactly one selected path records what happened in the accepted run.

label.description: Human-readable branch condition or observed answer.

selected.description: Whether this branch belongs to the observed evidence path.

observed.description: Observed workflow and verdicts parsed from the accepted Run, settled tool summaries, and receipts; oracle expectations never substitute for these values.

workflowKind.description: Actual tool path used by this run.

solveStatus.description: Observed settled solver status, or null when no solve was performed.

validationVerdict.description: Observed independent validation verdict, or null when the workflow has no validation step.

evidenceBindings.description: Immutable bindings that prevent a generic or stale tree from being presented as scenario evidence.

scenarioPackSha256.description: SHA-256 of the source Scenario Pack.

runId.description: Accepted run that supplied observed outcomes.

sourceMessagesSha256.description: SHA-256 of the source conversation log.

sourceSessionSha256.description: SHA-256 of the session log containing settled solve, validation, or recovery-ledger summaries.

sourceToolInvocationsSha256.description: SHA-256 of the governed tool receipt log that proves which workflow actually ran.

optimizationSpecSha256.description: OptimizationSpec hash when a solver path exists.

resultPayloadSha256.description: Settled solver-result hash or recovery EvidenceLedger payload hash; null only for validation-only candidate workflows.

validationReportSha256.description: Independent validation report hash when recorded.
